protocol.name: ARINC 664 Part 7 / AFDX-like demonstrator protocol
protocol.transport: stdio analysis harness: uint64 message id followed by uint64 payload

components.name: GNSS Receiver
components.description: GNSS receiver producing WGS-84 fixed-point position frames on an AFDX virtual link

components.name: Inertial Reference System
components.description: Independent IRS position estimate with an operational-region plausibility monitor

components.name: Radio Navigation Receiver
components.description: Independent DME/DME or VOR/DME fixed-point position source

components.name: Air Data Computer
components.description: Altitude, vertical-speed and indicated-airspeed source

components.name: Attitude and Heading Reference
components.description: Pitch, roll and true-heading source in centidegree fixed point

components.name: Weather Radar
components.description: Wind, turbulence and icing inputs used by the flight-management logic

components.name: Vulnerable Navigation Fusion
components.assurance: GNSS syntactic validation without cross-source consistency
components.known_defect: Any syntactically valid GNSS coordinate receives navigation authority
components.description: Trusts GNSS positions without applying the route-consistency safeguard

components.name: Flight Management System
components.description: Computes lateral guidance targets and publishes the causally tracked position

components.name: Flight Guidance Computer
components.description: Converts FMS and measured-attitude inputs into pitch/roll/yaw commands

components.name: Vulnerable Envelope Protection
components.assurance: pitch and roll limiting except in defective NAV_DIRECT mode
components.known_defect: NAV_DIRECT guidance bypasses the 18 degree pitch and 32 degree roll command limits
components.description: Contains a direct-mode protection bypass that can propagate spoof-induced over-bank commands

components.name: Actuator Control Electronics
components.description: Checks commands against physical travel, which is wider than the certified flight envelope

components.name: Aircraft Dynamics Effect
components.description: Classifies reachable position and attitude effects as nominal, diverged or unsafe

components.name: Primary Flight Display
components.description: Consumer-only terminal sink for nominal, diverged and unsafe aircraft states

components.name: EFB Data Loader Boundary
components.description: Models the EFB/DLS trust-boundary input as a fixed-width active-leg route load

components.name: Vulnerable Route Load Integrity
components.assurance: no signature, revision, or corridor enforcement
components.known_defect: Every DLS route load is granted active-route authority
components.description: Passes an untrusted EFB/DLS active-leg fix directly to the flight-management system

components.name: Adversarial Control-Domain Ingress
components.description: Synthetic boundary source for post-fusion navigation injection and forged guidance frames

components.name: Vulnerable AFDX Publisher Guard
components.known_defect: Untrusted navigation and guidance labels are republished onto authoritative virtual links
components.description: Converts an untrusted but well-formed frame into an authoritative navigation or guidance frame

components.name: Radio Altimeter Channel 1
components.assurance: ARINC-429 radio-height range and validity encoding
components.description: Publishes channel-1 radio height or an explicit invalid state below the 2,500 ft operating ceiling

components.name: Radio Altimeter Channel 2
components.description: Publishes the redundant channel-2 radio height or an explicit invalid state

components.name: Single-Channel Radio-Height Monitor
components.known_defect: A channel-1 invalid state makes radio height unavailable even when channel 2 is healthy
components.description: Tracks only radio-altimeter channel 1 and therefore cannot contain a single-side loss
